programs.title: Expedition Files
programs.desc: Josh Gates investigates sensationalistic stories, seeking the truth behind the unexplained: rock legend Jim Morrison's mysterious death, a bizarre, preserved mermaid found in a Japanese temple, and claims of alien abduction from a U.S. Airman.

programs.title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
programs.desc: A K9 scents illegal contents within luggage belonging to a preacher and his wife; to everyone's surprise, the wife admits to having cocaine in her bag; officers question a Brazilian man who arrives with two plastic dolls stuffed with white crystals.

programs.title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
programs.desc: Officers find chessboards loaded with more than 32 pieces; a couple who claimed only half the purchases they made abroad face a hefty fine and having their items seized; two travelers attempting to avoid immigration questions get caught.

programs.title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
programs.desc: Two UK women are questioned after one of them barely resembles her passport photo, and the officer suspects her documents are forged; a man returning home from an antique coin auction provides an officer with an ancient history lesson.

programs.title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
programs.desc: Rising tariffs tempt some citizens to go abroad to buy luxury goods, where items can be up to 40% cheaper, then bring them home without paying the proper duties. A traveler returning from Italy claims she has a $50,000 watch belonging to her brother.

programs.title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
programs.desc: In Atlanta, an officer discovers evidence of a lottery scam -- a tactic used by criminals to trick victims into giving up thousands of dollars in exchange for alleged winnings. This find could lead CBP to uncover the network behind this nefarious ploy.
